review: 702.62d: triaged as decision, but it decides that cost increases (601.2f) still apply to the free cast from suspend, which decides whether the cast is possible; reclassified as legality/direct/playability and added 702.62d-1 with Thalia, Guardian of Thraben.

scenarios.title: A card with suspend can be suspended only when it could begin to be cast
decisions: A suspends Rift Bolt from hand, paying its suspend cost {R} with Mountain.

variants.label: main_phase
variants.expected: Suspending is legal. Rift Bolt moves from A's hand to exile with one time counter, without using the stack, and Mountain is tapped.

variants.label: end_step
variants.delta: The step is A's end step, where a sorcery cannot be cast.
variants.expected: Suspending is not legal: Rift Bolt could not begin to be cast, so it stays in A's hand.

variants.label: cannot_pay
variants.expected: Suspending is not legal: the suspend cost {R} cannot be paid, so Rift Bolt stays in A's hand.

scenarios.forge_notes: The end-step variant sets setup.step to end; the tapped variant sets the Mountain's tapped flag.

scenarios.title: At the owner's upkeep a time counter is removed; removing the last allows a free cast
decisions: Beginning of A's upkeep: the suspend trigger goes on the stack and resolves, removing a time counter.
When the last time counter is removed, A casts Rift Bolt without paying its mana cost, targeting player B, and it resolves.

variants.label: last_counter
variants.expected: The upkeep trigger fires and the last time counter is removed. Rift Bolt is cast from exile, resolves, and B's life is 17.

variants.label: two_counters
variants.delta: Rift Bolt has two time counters.
variants.expected: The upkeep trigger fires and one time counter is removed. Rift Bolt stays in exile with one time counter and B's life is 20.

variants.label: opponents_upkeep
variants.delta: It is B's upkeep (B is the active player) instead of A's.
variants.expected: The suspend trigger does not fire. Rift Bolt stays in exile with one time counter and B's life is 20.

scenarios.title: A creature cast from suspend gains haste unless it cannot be cast
decisions: Beginning of A's upkeep: the suspend trigger resolves and removes the last time counter.
A casts Durkwood Baloth without paying its mana cost; it resolves and enters the battlefield.
In the declare attackers step A declares Durkwood Baloth as an attacker against player B.

variants.label: castable
variants.expected: Durkwood Baloth enters with haste and attacking is legal.

variants.label: cast_prohibited
variants.delta: A controls Steel Golem, so A cannot cast creature spells.
variants.expected: Durkwood Baloth cannot be cast and stays in exile with no time counters. It never enters and cannot attack.

scenarios.forge_notes: In the second variant, Steel Golem is on A's battlefield and not summoning sick; the attack decision does not occur.

scenarios.title: An effect that prohibits casting also prevents suspending
decisions: A tries to suspend Durkwood Baloth from hand, paying {G} with Forest.

variants.label: casting_prohibited
variants.expected: Suspending is not legal: A cannot cast creature spells, so Durkwood Baloth stays in A's hand.

variants.label: no_prohibition
variants.delta: Steel Golem is not on the battlefield.
variants.expected: Suspending is legal. Durkwood Baloth moves from A's hand to exile with five time counters.

scenarios.title: A cost increase applies to the free cast from suspend
decisions: Beginning of A's upkeep: the suspend trigger resolves and removes the last time counter.
When the last-counter trigger resolves, A tries to cast Rift Bolt without paying its mana cost, targeting player B.

variants.label: increase_unpayable
variants.expected: Thalia raises the cost to {1}, which A cannot pay, so Rift Bolt cannot be cast. It stays in exile with no time counters and B's life is 20.

variants.label: no_increase
variants.delta: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben is not on the battlefield.
variants.expected: Rift Bolt is cast for no mana, resolves, and B's life is 17.

variants.label: increase_paid
variants.expected: Rift Bolt is cast by paying {1}, tapping Mountain. It resolves and B's life is 17.
